title: The project directory got easier to navigate
summary:
A tidy day: clearer project discovery, fresher Python docs, and a less cluttered model shelf.

VibeCoder now lives under Tools & Interfaces, and Generator Text AI joined the project list. Two small map updates for a growing garden of things people have built.

The website's Python SDK example was updated so developers have a fresher starting point when making their first API call.

Redundant LLM model entries were removed, leaving a cleaner set of choices behind the unified text endpoint.
